name: Julie Turconi
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026 under the new rule: still out, now as too thin. Her own site (www.unicjuly.com, Montréal; robots.txt allows us) is mainly a visual artist's, writer's and storyteller's site. Its energy-care page (/soinsqt/) sells Quantum-Touch sessions ($80) on relieving pain and inflammation (inflammation is a condition claim under the brief's Quantum-Touch rule) alongside Access Bars sessions on the same page, so that page can't be used as an item. What passes is her Hunyuan Tai Ji Quan teaching (/arts-martiaux/: a winter community-centre session in Montréal, 16 Jan–3 Apr 2027, and 50+ taiji and mobility videos by subscription on Buy Me A Coffee): about two items, with no photo or published email checked yet, too little for a listing. Her contact on that page is a phone number and Facebook. Quantum-Touch leads are also parked (README §18.7). If the owner wants her as a tai chi teacher, the arts-martiaux page is the place to start.
